reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "tag": things in the home are tagged, so scenes rise like a tag being lifted. TikTok wants native editing, so hard cuts and whips lead.
Camera "dolly": constant forward movement for a high-energy feed.
Grounds light → accent → light → ink: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Sound-on placement: every transition, landing and reveal has a cue, and the bed ducks under the brand moment.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on TikTok (0.24s a word), inside 12–35s.
